summary: The voice roster SSE endpoint and browser/Flutter consumers now support a persistent stream with session revalidation and explicit session-expired handling. Focused backend and Flutter tests pass. Browser package execution, deployment, and live-session acceptance remain unverified, so the production roster failure is not resolved by this evidence alone.

checks.name: Backend roster handler and media route tests
checks.observation: Both packages passed, including the handler's session revalidation and session-expired behavior.

checks.name: Backend roster race detector
checks.observation: Both packages passed under the Go race detector.

checks.name: Flutter roster API and watcher tests
checks.observation: All 8 focused tests passed, including SSE 401 handling, session-expired handling, and stale watcher/subscription regressions.

checks.name: Web typecheck, full test suite and production build
checks.observation: TypeScript typecheck passed; all 241 test files and 760 tests passed; Vite production build passed. Vite emitted its existing advisory that the main JavaScript chunk exceeds 500 kB.

checks.name: OpenAPI YAML syntax
checks.observation: The updated OpenAPI file parses as YAML. Its JSON representation and roster endpoint predicates were also checked separately. This does not replace the full repository contract verifier.

checks.name: Roster contract predicates
checks.command: jq -e '<watchConnectedVoiceParticipants SSE, status, microphone_muted, and session-expired assertions>' contracts/openapi.yaml
checks.observation: JSON parsing and focused assertions for the SSE endpoint, 401/500/503 outcomes, required microphone_muted field, and session-expired documentation passed.

checks.name: Approved requirement index references
checks.command: ruby -rjson -e 'check 39 unique IDs from backlog/approved-requirements.json are referenced in backlog/tasks.yaml'
checks.observation: All 39 unique indexed requirement IDs are referenced by backlog/tasks.yaml. The approved brief itself is not present at the Windows-only configured path on this host.

checks.name: Contract and traceability PowerShell verifiers
checks.observation: Neither pwsh nor powershell is installed in this environment; repository contract and spec-traceability verifier scripts could not be run.

checks.name: Production deployment and live browser/Flutter session acceptance
checks.observation: No server deployment or live two-client session revocation/reconnect test was performed. The observed SHARE_TEST roster failure's production cause remains unknown.

limits: Changes are uncommitted. No server/LiveKit logs were correlated, no two-account ACL/privacy runtime test was performed, and no claim is made that the production failure is fixed.
